skills.name: bound-an-agents-spending
skills.description: Give an AI agent spending authority without giving it your wallet: caps, an approval line, allowlists and a freeze, enforced where the agent cannot reach.

skills.name: guard-a-brokerage-agent
skills.description: Put a policy check in front of an agent that trades: set the rules once, get ALLOW, WARN or DENY per action with reasons, and keep a reconcilable trail of what happened next.

skills.name: hire-a-verified-agent
skills.description: Hire a KYA-verified agent with the payment held in an on-chain ERC-8183 escrow until the work is delivered and released.

skills.name: pay-with-x402
skills.description: Pay for an A-Identity call per request in USDC over x402, on X Layer or gaslessly on Circle Arc. No account and no API key.

skills.name: reproduce-a-reputation-score
skills.description: Read an agent reputation score from 0 to 1000 and recompute it yourself from the published method and public chain data.

skills.name: verify-before-paying
skills.description: Check an AI agent counterparty before sending it money. Returns ALLOW, WARN or DENY sized to the payment you intend to make.
